statement: A service in gateway mode counts every refusal of a forwarded identity by problem type (`cosec.identity.refused{problem}`, whose values are the closed set of problems the gate answers, registered with cosec-micrometer and a MeterRegistry and kept without them), including those its log does not print, and logs the refusal's reason at WARN, at most once per interval for each problem type; the logged reason carries nothing of the header unescaped or unbounded (a control character or an unpaired surrogate as its `\uXXXX` escape, a name at most 64 characters, at most three names, a parse error by its location, never its text), and the response carries the problem only, never the reason.
guards: runtime:IdentityRefusalsTest#every refusal is counted by problem type, also those the bounded warning does not print
runtime:IdentityRefusalsTest#a request the gate lets through counts nothing, and no other problem is counted
runtime:IdentityRefusalsTest#the gate warns once for a flood of bad headers, and the response says only the problem
runtime:IdentityRefusalsTest#each problem type warns again once its interval has passed
micrometer:IdentityRefusedMetricTest#each refusal counts in the series of its problem, and the series are the gate's problems only
spring-boot:GatewayModeMetricsTest#the gate's refusals are counted in the registry by problem
spring-boot:GatewayModeMetricsTest#without cosec-micrometer or a registry the gate still counts, and nothing fails
runtime:IdentityRefusalsTest#a forged header writes one bounded warning line, with nothing of the header unescaped
document:IdentityCodecMessageTest#a claim name is escaped and bounded
document:IdentityCodecMessageTest#members crit names and this version lacks are bounded, at most three named, and a forged entry is not quoted
document:IdentityCodecMessageTest#text that is not JSON is named by where it fails, never by what it holds
